$comment: Head of a revocation log (task P2.1), kept by the custodian next to the log and rewritten after every append and at least every max-status-age: count is the number of records including genesis, last_sha256 the canonical SHA-256 of the last record, as_of when the custodian last confirmed the log complete, source the status source that relying records name (release validity.status_source, attestation lifecycle.status_source). A log is trusted only together with a fresh head from the expected source; in protected use both must come from the custodian identity (contracts/trusted_input.py).
